title: ""
page-layout: full

format:
  html:
    html-math-method: katex

<style>
.dash-container {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 1.5rem auto 4rem auto;
  padding: 0 1rem;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
}
.dash-header-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #0f172a;
}
.dash-header {
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: #000000;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0;
}
.dash-subtitle {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #475569;
  margin: 0;
}
.dash-status-pill {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
  background: #f3e8ff;
  color: #2e1065;
  border: 1px solid #d8b4fe;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.dash-pulse {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #16a34a;
  display: inline-block;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.6);
  animation: dashPulse 1.8s infinite;
}
@keyframes dashPulse {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.6); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px rgba(22, 163, 74, 0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0); }
}
.dash-section {
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}
.dash-section-banner {
  border-left: 4px solid #5b21b6;
  padding: 0.2rem 0 0.5rem 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.35rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}
.dash-section-title {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0f172a;
  margin: 0;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}
.dash-section-meta {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #64748b;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.dash-grid-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(460px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
}
.dash-grid-3 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(340px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .dash-grid-2, .dash-grid-3 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
.dash-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}
.dash-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}
.dash-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  align-self: flex-start;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  padding: 0.22rem 0.55rem;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  background: #f3e8ff;
  color: #5b21b6;
}
.dash-card-title {
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0f172a;
  margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0;
}
.dash-card-desc {
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  color: #475569;
  line-height: 1.45;
  margin: 0 0 0.9rem 0;
}
.dash-input-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
}
.dash-input-grid-4 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 0.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .dash-input-grid-4 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
}
.dash-field label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #334155;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}
.dash-field input, .dash-field select {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #0f172a;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  outline: none;
}
.dash-field input:focus, .dash-field select:focus {
  border-color: #6d28d9;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(109, 40, 217, 0.12);
}
.dash-readout {
  background: #09090b;
  color: #f8fafc;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem;
  font-family: "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, Menlo, monospace;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
}
.dash-readout-accent {
  color: #c084fc;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.dash-readout-orange {
  color: #fb923c;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.dash-readout-cyan {
  color: #38bdf8;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.dash-btn-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
}
.dash-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  background-color: #191326;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  border: none;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem;
  border-radius: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease;
}
.dash-btn:hover {
  background-color: #4c1d95;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}
.dash-btn-outline {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #2e1065 !important;
  border: 1px solid #c084fc;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color 0.15s ease;
}
.dash-btn-outline:hover {
  background-color: #f3e8ff;
}
.dash-btn-tab-active {
  background-color: #2e1065 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border: 1px solid #2e1065 !important;
}
.law-strip {
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-left: 3px solid #5b21b6;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: #1e293b;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.matrix-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
}
.matrix-table td {
  padding: 0.22rem;
}
.matrix-table input {
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.38rem;
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #f8fafc;
}
.potd-schematic-box {
  width: 100%;
  height: 165px;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.potd-schematic-box svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.launcher-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}
.launcher-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07);
  border-color: #cbd5e1;
}
.launcher-visual {
  height: 150px;
  background: #ffffff;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
}
.launcher-visual svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}
.launcher-body {
  padding: 1.15rem 1.4rem 1.4rem 1.4rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  flex-grow: 1;
}
.telemetry-strip {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  color: #1e293b;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}
</style>

<div class="dash-container">

<div class="dash-header-row">
<div>
<h1 class="dash-header">ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING COMMAND CENTER</h1>
<p class="dash-subtitle">Real-Time Bench Utilities, Mesh/Nodal Matrix Solver, Daily Circuit Challenge &amp; Simulation Telemetry</p>
</div>
<div class="dash-status-pill">
<span class="dash-pulse"></span> Bench Telemetry Online &bull; 6 Utilities + 6 Labs
</div>
</div>

<div class="dash-section">
<div class="dash-section-banner">
<h2 class="dash-section-title">1. Master Bench Calculator Grid (Tiles A &ndash; F)</h2>
<span class="dash-section-meta">Instant Sanity-Check Solvers for DC/AC Homework, Lab Wiring &amp; Network Theorems</span>
</div>

<div class="dash-grid-2">

<div class="dash-card">
<div>
<span class="dash-tag">Tile A &bull; Ohm's Law &amp; DC Power</span>
<h3 class="dash-card-title">Ohm's Law ($V = I \cdot R$) &amp; Power Matrix Solver</h3>
<p class="dash-card-desc">Enter <strong>any two</strong> parameters ($V$, $I$, $R$, or $P$) to compute the remaining unknowns.</p>

<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr; gap:0.75rem; align-items:center; margin-bottom:0.75rem;">
<div class="law-strip" style="margin-bottom:0;">
<strong>Ohm's Law:</strong><br>
$V = I \cdot R \quad \big| \quad I = \dfrac{V}{R} \quad \big| \quad R = \dfrac{V}{I}$<br>
<strong>Watt's Power Law:</strong><br>
$P = V \cdot I = I^2 R = \dfrac{V^2}{R}$
</div>
<svg viewBox="0 0 210 115" style="width:100%; height:105px; background:#f8fafc; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:4px;">
<polygon points="60,10 12,102 108,102" fill="#f3e8ff" stroke="#2e1065" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="36" y1="56" x2="84" y2="56" stroke="#2e1065" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="60" y1="56" x2="60" y2="102" stroke="#2e1065" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="60" y="46" fill="#2e1065" font-size="16" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">V</text>
<text x="42" y="88" fill="#e86c3a" font-size="15" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">I</text>
<text x="78" y="88" fill="#1e3a5f" font-size="15" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">R</text>
<text x="60" y="112" fill="#475569" font-size="8.5" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">V = I &middot; R</text>
<polygon points="158,10 114,102 202,102" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="136" y1="56" x2="180" y2="56" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="158" y1="56" x2="158" y2="102" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="158" y="46" fill="#e86c3a" font-size="16" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">P</text>
<text x="141" y="88" fill="#2e1065" font-size="15" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">V</text>
<text x="175" y="88" fill="#1e3a5f" font-size="15" font-weight="800" text-anchor="middle">I</text>
<text x="158" y="112" fill="#475569" font-size="8.5" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">P = V &middot; I</text>
</svg>
</div>

<div class="dash-input-grid">
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Voltage $V$ (Volts)</label>
<input type="number" id="ohmV" step="any" placeholder="e.g. 12" value="12">
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Current $I$ (Amps)</label>
<input type="number" id="ohmI" step="any" placeholder="e.g. 0.5">
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Resistance $R$ ($\Omega$)</label>
<input type="number" id="ohmR" step="any" placeholder="e.g. 24" value="24">
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Power $P$ (Watts)</label>
<input type="number" id="ohmP" step="any" placeholder="e.g. 6">
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div class="dash-readout" id="ohmReadout"></div>
<div class="dash-btn-row">
<button class="dash-btn" onclick="solveOhm()">Compute Unknowns</button>
<button class="dash-btn-outline" onclick="clearOhm()">Clear Fields</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="dash-card">
<div>
<span class="dash-tag">Tile B &bull; 1st-Order Transients</span>
<h3 class="dash-card-title">RC / RL Time Constant ($\tau$) &amp; Cutoff Solver</h3>
<p class="dash-card-desc">Compute the time constant $\tau$, $5\tau$ settling time, and $-3\text{ dB}$ corner frequency $f_c = \frac{1}{2\pi\tau}$.</p>
<div class="dash-input-grid">
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Network Topology</label>
<select id="tauMode" onchange="solveTau()">
<option value="rc">Series RC Network (&tau; = R &middot; C)</option>
<option value="rl">Series RL Network (&tau; = L / R)</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Resistance $R$ ($\text{k}\Omega$)</label>
<input type="number" id="tauR" step="any" value="10" oninput="solveTau()">
</div>
<div class="dash-field" id="tauCapField">
<label id="tauReactLabel">Capacitance $C$ ($\mu\text{F}$)</label>
<input type="number" id="tauC" step="any" value="4.7" oninput="solveTau()">
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Target Step $V_s$ (V)</label>
<input type="number" id="tauVs" step="any" value="5.0" oninput="solveTau()">
</div>
</div>

<svg viewBox="0 0 360 150" style="width:100%; height:155px; background:#f8fafc; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:6px; margin-bottom:0.45rem;">
<line x1="42" y1="22" x2="342" y2="22" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
<line x1="42" y1="59" x2="112" y2="59" stroke="#e86c3a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
<line x1="112" y1="59" x2="112" y2="125" stroke="#e86c3a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
<line x1="305" y1="23" x2="305" y2="125" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.1" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
<line x1="42" y1="12" x2="42" y2="125" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.6"/>
<line x1="42" y1="125" x2="346" y2="125" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.6"/>
<path d="M 42 125 C 65 78, 88 66, 112 59 C 165 36, 225 25, 342 22.5" fill="none" stroke="#5b21b6" stroke-width="3"/>
<circle cx="112" cy="59" r="4.5" fill="#e86c3a" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<circle cx="305" cy="23" r="4.5" fill="#1e3a5f" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="36" y="25" fill="#1e293b" font-size="9.5" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end" id="svgVsTop">5.0V</text>
<text x="36" y="62" fill="#e86c3a" font-size="9" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end" id="svgVs63">3.2V</text>
<text x="36" y="128" fill="#64748b" font-size="9" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="end">0V</text>
<text x="118" y="64" fill="#1e293b" font-size="10" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" id="svgTauLabel">1&tau; (63.2%): 47.0 ms</text>
<text x="195" y="42" fill="#1e3a5f" font-size="10" font-family="monospace" font-weight="bold" id="svg5TauLabel">5&tau; (99.3%): 235.0 ms</text>
<text x="195" y="142" fill="#475569" font-size="9.5" font-family="monospace" text-anchor="middle">Transient Step Response v(t) = Vs &middot; (1 &minus; e^(&minus;t/&tau;))</text>
</svg>
</div>
<div class="dash-readout" id="tauReadout"></div>
</div>

<div class="dash-card">
<div>
<span class="dash-tag">Tile C &bull; Component Metrology</span>
<h3 class="dash-card-title">4-Band Resistor Color Decoder &amp; E12 Matcher</h3>
<p class="dash-card-desc">Select resistor color bands to decode nominal resistance, tolerance bounds, and closest standard E12 value.</p>
<div class="dash-input-grid">
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Band 1 (1st Digit)</label>
<select id="band1" onchange="solveResistor()">
<option value="1" selected>Brown (1)</option>
<option value="2">Red (2)</option>
<option value="3">Orange (3)</option>
<option value="4">Yellow (4)</option>
<option value="5">Green (5)</option>
<option value="6">Blue (6)</option>
<option value="7">Violet (7)</option>
<option value="8">Grey (8)</option>
<option value="9">White (9)</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Band 2 (2nd Digit)</label>
<select id="band2" onchange="solveResistor()">
<option value="0" selected>Black (0)</option>
<option value="1">Brown (1)</option>
<option value="2">Red (2)</option>
<option value="3">Orange (3)</option>
<option value="4">Yellow (4)</option>
<option value="5">Green (5)</option>
<option value="6">Blue (6)</option>
<option value="7">Violet (7)</option>
<option value="8">Grey (8)</option>
<option value="9">White (9)</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Band 3 (Multiplier)</label>
<select id="bandMult" onchange="solveResistor()">
<option value="1">Black (&times;1 &Omega;)</option>
<option value="10">Brown (&times;10 &Omega;)</option>
<option value="100" selected>Red (&times;100 &Omega;)</option>
<option value="1000">Orange (&times;1 k&Omega;)</option>
<option value="10000">Yellow (&times;10 k&Omega;)</option>
<option value="100000">Green (&times;100 k&Omega;)</option>
<option value="1000000">Blue (&times;1 M&Omega;)</option>
</select>
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Band 4 (Tolerance)</label>
<select id="bandTol" onchange="solveResistor()">
<option value="1">&plusmn;1% (Brown)</option>
<option value="2">&plusmn;2% (Red)</option>
<option value="5" selected>&plusmn;5% (Gold)</option>
<option value="10">&plusmn;10% (Silver)</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>
<svg viewBox="0 0 360 66" style="width:100%; height:62px; background:#f8fafc; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:0.4rem;">
<line x1="20" y1="33" x2="340" y2="33" stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="4.5"/>
<rect x="75" y="11" width="210" height="44" rx="12" fill="#f5deb3" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect id="svgB1" x="102" y="11" width="15" height="44" fill="#8b4513"/>
<rect id="svgB2" x="134" y="11" width="15" height="44" fill="#000000"/>
<rect id="svgB3" x="166" y="11" width="15" height="44" fill="#dc2626"/>
<rect id="svgB4" x="235" y="11" width="15" height="44" fill="#eab308"/>
</svg>
</div>
<div class="dash-readout" id="resReadout"></div>
</div>

<div class="dash-card">
<div>
<span class="dash-tag">Tile D &bull; Amplifier &amp; Filter Gain</span>
<h3 class="dash-card-title">Decibel (dB) Gain &amp; Attenuation Converter</h3>
<p class="dash-card-desc">Compute linear ratio $A_v = V_{\text{out}}/V_{\text{in}}$, voltage dB ($20\log_{10}$), and power dB ($10\log_{10}$).</p>
<div class="dash-input-grid">
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Input Signal $V_{\text{in}}$ (V or W)</label>
<input type="number" id="dbVin" step="any" value="1.0" oninput="solveDb()">
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Output Signal $V_{\text{out}}$ (V or W)</label>
<input type="number" id="dbVout" step="any" value="0.7071" oninput="solveDb()">
</div>
</div>
<div class="dash-btn-row" style="margin-top:0; margin-bottom:0.75rem;">
<button class="dash-btn-outline" onclick="setDbPreset(1, 0.7071)">-3 dB Cutoff (0.707x)</button>
<button class="dash-btn-outline" onclick="setDbPreset(1, 10)">+20 dB Gain (10x)</button>
<button class="dash-btn-outline" onclick="setDbPreset(1, 100)">+40 dB Gain (100x)</button>
</div>
</div>
<div class="dash-readout" id="dbReadout"></div>
</div>

<div class="dash-card">
<div>
<span class="dash-tag">Tile E &bull; AC Phasors &amp; Complex Impedance</span>
<h3 class="dash-card-title">RLC Complex Impedance ($Z$) &amp; Phasor Solver</h3>
<p class="dash-card-desc">Compute $X_L = 2\pi fL$, $X_C = \frac{1}{2\pi fC}$, rectangular $Z = R + j(X_L - X_C)$, polar $|Z|\angle\theta$, and resonance $f_0$.</p>
<div class="dash-input-grid-4">
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Freq $f$ (Hz)</label>
<input type="number" id="rlcF" step="any" value="1000" oninput="solveRlcZ()">
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Res $R$ ($\Omega$)</label>
<input type="number" id="rlcR" step="any" value="100" oninput="solveRlcZ()">
</div>
<div class="dash-field">
<label>Ind $L$ (mH)</label>

<script>
// ================= TILE A: OHM'S LAW & POWER SOLVER =================
window.solveOhm = function() {
  const vEl = document.getElementById('ohmV');
  const iEl = document.getElementById('ohmI');
  const rEl = document.getElementById('ohmR');
  const pEl = document.getElementById('ohmP');
  const out = document.getElementById('ohmReadout');

  let V = parseFloat(vEl.value);
  let I = parseFloat(iEl.value);
  let R = parseFloat(rEl.value);
  let P = parseFloat(pEl.value);

  const knowns = [!isNaN(V), !isNaN(I), !isNaN(R), !isNaN(P)].filter(Boolean).length;
  if (knowns < 2) {
    out.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-readout-orange">Please enter at least 2 values (e.g., V and R) to solve the network.</span>`;
    return;
  }

  let formula = "";
  if (!isNaN(V) && !isNaN(R) && R > 0) {
    I = V / R;
    P = (V * V) / R;
    formula = "Ohm's Law: I = V / R | Watt's Law: P = V² / R";
  } else if (!isNaN(V) && !isNaN(I)) {
    R = I !== 0 ? V / I : 0;
    P = V * I;
    formula = "Ohm's Law: R = V / I | Watt's Law: P = V · I";
  } else if (!isNaN(I) && !isNaN(R)) {
    V = I * R;
    P = I * I * R;
    formula = "Ohm's Law: V = I · R | Watt's Law: P = I² · R";
  } else if (!isNaN(P) && !isNaN(R) && R > 0) {
    V = Math.sqrt(P * R);
    I = Math.sqrt(P / R);
    formula = "Derived: V = √(P · R) | I = √(P / R)";
  } else if (!isNaN(P) && !isNaN(V) && V !== 0) {
    I = P / V;
    R = (V * V) / P;
    formula = "Derived: I = P / V | R = V² / P";
  } else if (!isNaN(P) && !isNaN(I) && I !== 0) {
    V = P / I;
    R = P / (I * I);
    formula = "Derived: V = P / I | R = P / I²";
  }

  vEl.value = V.toFixed(4);
  iEl.value = I.toFixed(4);
  rEl.value = R.toFixed(4);
  pEl.value = P.toFixed(4);

  out.innerHTML = `V = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${V.toFixed(3)} V</span> | I = <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${I.toFixed(4)} A (${(I*1000).toFixed(2)} mA)</span><br>R = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${R.toFixed(3)} &Omega;</span> | P = <span class="dash-readout-orange">${P.toFixed(3)} W (${(P*1000).toFixed(1)} mW)</span><br><span style="color:#a1a1aa; font-size:0.75rem;">${formula}</span>`;
};

window.clearOhm = function() {
  document.getElementById('ohmV').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ohmI').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ohmR').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ohmP').value = '';
  document.getElementById('ohmReadout').innerHTML = 'Fields cleared. Enter any 2 parameters and click Compute Unknowns.';
};

// ================= TILE B: RC / RL TIME CONSTANT SOLVER =================
window.solveTau = function() {
  const mode = document.getElementById('tauMode').value;
  const R_k = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tauR').value) || 1;
  const X_val = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tauC').value) || 1;
  const Vs = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tauVs').value) || 5;
  const label = document.getElementById('tauReactLabel');

  const R = R_k * 1000;
  let tau = 0;
  if (mode === 'rc') {
    label.innerHTML = 'Capacitance C (&mu;F)';
    const C = X_val * 1e-6;
    tau = R * C;
  } else {
    label.innerHTML = 'Inductance L (mH)';
    const L = X_val * 1e-3;
    tau = L / R;
  }

  const tau_ms = tau * 1000;
  const fc = tau > 0 ? 1 / (2 * Math.PI * tau) : 0;
  const v1 = Vs * (1 - Math.exp(-1));
  const v5 = Vs * (1 - Math.exp(-5));

  const unitStr = tau_ms >= 1 ? `${tau_ms.toFixed(3)} ms` : `${(tau * 1e6).toFixed(2)} &mu;s`;
  const fiveUnitStr = (tau_ms * 5) >= 1 ? `${(tau_ms * 5).toFixed(2)} ms` : `${(tau * 5e6).toFixed(1)} &mu;s`;

  document.getElementById('svgVsTop').textContent = `${Vs.toFixed(1)}V`;
  document.getElementById('svgVs63').textContent = `${v1.toFixed(1)}V`;
  document.getElementById('svgTauLabel').textContent = `1τ (63.2%): ${tau_ms >= 1 ? tau_ms.toFixed(1) + ' ms' : (tau*1e6).toFixed(1) + ' μs'}`;
  document.getElementById('svg5TauLabel').textContent = `5τ (99.3%): ${(tau_ms*5) >= 1 ? (tau_ms*5).toFixed(1) + ' ms' : (tau*5e6).toFixed(1) + ' μs'}`;

  document.getElementById('tauReadout').innerHTML = `&tau; = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${unitStr}</span> | Settling (5&tau;) = <span class="dash-readout-orange">${fiveUnitStr}</span><br>V(1&tau;) = <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${v1.toFixed(2)} V</span> | V(5&tau;) = <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${v5.toFixed(2)} V</span> | Cutoff f<sub>c</sub> = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${fc.toFixed(2)} Hz</span>`;
};

// ================= TILE C: 4-BAND RESISTOR DECODER =================
const bandHex = {
  "0": "#000000", "1": "#8b4513", "2": "#dc2626", "3": "#f97316",
  "4": "#facc15", "5": "#16a34a", "6": "#2563eb", "7": "#7c3aed",
  "8": "#64748b", "9": "#ffffff"
};
const multHex = {
  "1": "#000000", "10": "#8b4513", "100": "#dc2626", "1000": "#f97316",
  "10000": "#facc15", "100000": "#16a34a", "1000000": "#2563eb"
};
const tolHex = { "1": "#8b4513", "2": "#dc2626", "5": "#eab308", "10": "#94a3b8" };
const e12Series = [10, 12, 15, 18, 22, 27, 33, 39, 47, 56, 68, 82, 100];

function formatOhms(r) {
  if (r >= 1e6) return (r / 1e6).toFixed(2) + " M&Omega;";
  if (r >= 1e3) return (r / 1e3).toFixed(2) + " k&Omega;";
  return r.toFixed(1) + " &Omega;";
}

window.solveResistor = function() {
  const b1 = document.getElementById('band1').value;
  const b2 = document.getElementById('band2').value;
  const mult = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bandMult').value);
  const tol = parseFloat(document.getElementById('bandTol').value);

  document.getElementById('svgB1').setAttribute('fill', bandHex[b1]);
  document.getElementById('svgB2').setAttribute('fill', bandHex[b2]);
  document.getElementById('svgB3').setAttribute('fill', multHex[String(mult)]);
  document.getElementById('svgB4').setAttribute('fill', tolHex[String(tol)]);

  const baseVal = parseInt(b1) * 10 + parseInt(b2);
  const R = baseVal * mult;
  const rMin = R * (1 - tol / 100);
  const rMax = R * (1 + tol / 100);

  let closestE12 = e12Series[0];
  let minDiff = Math.abs(baseVal - closestE12);
  for (let i = 1; i < e12Series.length; i++) {
    const d = Math.abs(baseVal - e12Series[i]);
    if (d < minDiff) { minDiff = d; closestE12 = e12Series[i]; }
  }
  const e12Val = closestE12 * mult;

  document.getElementById('resReadout').innerHTML = `Nominal R = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${formatOhms(R)} &plusmn;${tol}%</span><br>Range: [<span class="dash-readout-cyan">${formatOhms(rMin)}</span> to <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${formatOhms(rMax)}</span>]<br>Closest Standard E12 Stock: <span class="dash-readout-orange">${formatOhms(e12Val)}</span>`;
};

// ================= TILE D: DECIBEL CONVERTER =================
window.solveDb = function() {
  const vin = parseFloat(document.getElementById('dbVin').value) || 1;
  const vout = parseFloat(document.getElementById('dbVout').value) || 1;
  const out = document.getElementById('dbReadout');

  if (vin <= 0 || vout <= 0) {
    out.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-readout-orange">Signal magnitudes must be positive (> 0).</span>`;
    return;
  }

  const ratio = vout / vin;
  const dbV = 20 * Math.log10(ratio);
  const dbP = 10 * Math.log10(ratio);
  const stateLabel = Math.abs(dbV + 3.01) < 0.15
    ? "Half-Power Cutoff Point (-3 dB)"
    : (dbV > 0 ? "Amplification (+Gain)" : (dbV < 0 ? "Attenuation (-Loss)" : "Unity Gain (0 dB)"));

  out.innerHTML = `Linear Ratio (V<sub>out</sub>/V<sub>in</sub>) = <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${ratio.toFixed(4)} V/V</span><br>Voltage Gain (20 log<sub>10</sub>) = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${dbV >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${dbV.toFixed(2)} dB</span> | Power (10 log<sub>10</sub>) = <span class="dash-readout-orange">${dbP >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${dbP.toFixed(2)} dB</span><br>Regime: <span style="color:#a1a1aa;">${stateLabel}</span>`;
};

window.setDbPreset = function(vin, vout) {
  document.getElementById('dbVin').value = vin;
  document.getElementById('dbVout').value = vout;
  solveDb();
};

// ================= TILE E: RLC COMPLEX IMPEDANCE SOLVER =================
window.solveRlcZ = function() {
  const f = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rlcF').value) || 0;
  const R = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rlcR').value) || 0;
  const L_mH = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rlcL').value) || 0;
  const C_uF = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rlcC').value) || 0;

  const L = L_mH * 1e-3;
  const C = C_uF * 1e-6;
  const w = 2 * Math.PI * f;

  const XL = w * L;
  const XC = (w > 0 && C > 0) ? 1 / (w * C) : 0;
  const Xnet = XL - XC;
  const Zmag = Math.sqrt(R * R + Xnet * Xnet);
  const thetaDeg = Math.atan2(Xnet, R) * (180 / Math.PI);
  const pf = Zmag > 0 ? Math.cos(thetaDeg * Math.PI / 180) : 1;
  const f0 = (L > 0 && C > 0) ? 1 / (2 * Math.PI * Math.sqrt(L * C)) : 0;

  const signStr = Xnet >= 0 ? `+ j${Xnet.toFixed(2)}` : `- j${Math.abs(Xnet).toFixed(2)}`;
  const regime = Math.abs(Xnet) < 0.05 ? "Resonant (Unity PF)" : (Xnet > 0 ? "Inductive (Lagging PF)" : "Capacitive (Leading PF)");

  document.getElementById('svgZReal').textContent = `Real R = ${R.toFixed(1)} Ω`;
  document.getElementById('svgZImag').textContent = `j(XL - XC) = ${Xnet >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Xnet.toFixed(1)} Ω`;
  document.getElementById('svgZMag').textContent = `|Z| = ${Zmag.toFixed(1)} Ω`;
  document.getElementById('svgZAngle').textContent = `θ = ${thetaDeg >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${thetaDeg.toFixed(1)}°`;

  document.getElementById('rlcZReadout').innerHTML = `X<sub>L</sub> = <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${XL.toFixed(2)} &Omega;</span> | X<sub>C</sub> = <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${XC.toFixed(2)} &Omega;</span> | f<sub>0</sub> = <span class="dash-readout-orange">${f0.toFixed(1)} Hz</span><br>Rect: Z = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${R.toFixed(2)} ${signStr} &Omega;</span> | Polar: <span class="dash-readout-accent">${Zmag.toFixed(2)} &Omega; &angle; ${thetaDeg.toFixed(2)}&deg;</span><br>Power Factor (cos &theta;) = <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${pf.toFixed(3)}</span> (<span style="color:#a1a1aa;">${regime}</span>)`;
};

// ================= TILE F: SERIES / PARALLEL R, L, C EQUIVALENT SOLVER =================
window.solveEqNetwork = function() {
  const comp = document.getElementById('eqComp').value;
  const topo = document.getElementById('eqTopo').value;
  const v1 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('eqVal1').value);
  const v2 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('eqVal2').value);
  const v3 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('eqVal3').value);

  const unitMap = { R: "&Omega;", L: "mH", C: "&mu;F" };
  const unit = unitMap[comp];

  document.getElementById('eqLab1').innerHTML = `${comp}<sub>1</sub> (${unit})`;
  document.getElementById('eqLab2').innerHTML = `${comp}<sub>2</sub> (${unit})`;
  document.getElementById('eqLab3').innerHTML = `${comp}<sub>3</sub> (Opt ${unit})`;

  const vals = [v1, v2, v3].filter(v => !isNaN(v) && v > 0);
  const out = document.getElementById('eqNetReadout');
  if (vals.length === 0) {
    out.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-readout-orange">Enter at least one positive branch value.</span>`;
    return;
  }

  const isAdditive = (comp === 'R' && topo === 'series') ||
                     (comp === 'L' && topo === 'series') ||
                     (comp === 'C' && topo === 'parallel');

  let eq = 0;
  let formulaStr = "";
  if (isAdditive) {
    eq = vals.reduce((acc, x) => acc + x, 0);
    formulaStr = `${comp}<sub>eq</sub> = ` + vals.map((_, i) => `${comp}<sub>${i+1}</sub>`).join(' + ');
  } else {
    const invSum = vals.reduce((acc, x) => acc + (1 / x), 0);
    eq = invSum > 0 ? 1 / invSum : 0;
    formulaStr = `1/${comp}<sub>eq</sub> = ` + vals.map((_, i) => `1/${comp}<sub>${i+1}</sub>`).join(' + ');
  }

  out.innerHTML = `Equivalent ${comp}<sub>eq</sub> (${topo.toUpperCase()}) = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${eq.toFixed(4)} ${unit}</span><br>Active Law: <span class="dash-readout-cyan">${formulaStr}</span> (${vals.length} active branches)`;
};

let potdIdx = new Date().getDate() % potdBank.length;
let potdShowSteps = false;

function renderPotd() {
  const p = potdBank[potdIdx];
  document.getElementById('potdTopicTag').textContent = p.topic;
  document.getElementById('potdDiffBadge').textContent = p.diff;
  document.getElementById('potdTitle').textContent = p.title;
  document.getElementById('potdSchematic').innerHTML = p.svg;
  document.getElementById('potdPrompt').textContent = p.prompt;
  document.getElementById('potdInputLabel').textContent = `Your Answer (${p.unit})`;
  document.getElementById('potdUserAns').value = '';
  const fb = document.getElementById('potdFeedback');
  fb.style.display = 'none';
  potdShowSteps = false;
}

window.checkPotd = function() {
  const p = potdBank[potdIdx];
  const userVal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('potdUserAns').value);
  const fb = document.getElementById('potdFeedback');
  fb.style.display = 'block';

  if (isNaN(userVal)) {
    fb.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-readout-orange">Enter a numerical value in ${p.unit} to verify your solution.</span>`;
    return;
  }

  const pass = Math.abs(userVal - p.answer) <= p.tol;
  if (pass) {
    fb.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-readout-cyan">✓ Correct! (${p.answer} ${p.unit})</span><br>${p.steps}`;
  } else {
    fb.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-readout-orange">✗ Not quite (${userVal} ${p.unit}). Expected ${p.answer} ${p.unit}.</span><br>${p.steps}`;
  }
};

window.togglePotdSolution = function() {
  const p = potdBank[potdIdx];
  const fb = document.getElementById('potdFeedback');
  potdShowSteps = !potdShowSteps;
  if (potdShowSteps) {
    fb.style.display = 'block';
    fb.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-readout-accent">Step-by-Step Solution (${p.answer} ${p.unit}):</span><br>${p.steps}`;
  } else {
    fb.style.display = 'none';
  }
};

window.nextPotd = function() {
  potdIdx = (potdIdx + 1) % potdBank.length;
  renderPotd();
};

// ================= SECTION 2B: 2x2 & 3x3 MESH RESISTANCE MATRIX SOLVER =================
let activeMatrixDim = 2;

const meshPresets = {
  2: { M: [[15, -5], [-5, 20]], S: [12.0, 0.0] },
  3: { M: [[20, -6, -4], [-6, 18, -5], [-4, -5, 15]], S: [24.0, 0.0, 12.0] }
};
const nodalPresets = {
  2: { M: [[0.15, -0.05], [-0.05, 0.10]], S: [2.0, 1.0] },
  3: { M: [[0.30, -0.10, -0.10], [-0.10, 0.25, -0.05], [-0.10, -0.05, 0.20]], S: [3.0, 0.0, 1.5] }
};

window.setMatrixDim = function(n) {
  activeMatrixDim = n;
  document.getElementById('btnMat2').className = n === 2 ? 'dash-btn-outline dash-btn-tab-active' : 'dash-btn-outline';
  document.getElementById('btnMat3').className = n === 3 ? 'dash-btn-outline dash-btn-tab-active' : 'dash-btn-outline';
  renderMatrixInputs();
};

window.renderMatrixInputs = function() {
  const n = activeMatrixDim;
  const domain = document.getElementById('matDomain').value;
  const container = document.getElementById('matrixInputContainer');
  const preset = domain === 'mesh' ? meshPresets[n] : nodalPresets[n];

  const coeffSym = domain === 'mesh' ? 'R' : 'G';
  const coeffUnit = domain === 'mesh' ? '&Omega;' : 'S';
  const unkSym = domain === 'mesh' ? 'I' : 'V';
  const srcSym = domain === 'mesh' ? 'V' : 'I';
  const srcUnit = domain === 'mesh' ? 'V' : 'A';

  let html = '<table class="matrix-table"><thead><tr>';
  for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
    html += `<th style="font-size:0.72rem; color:#475569; text-align:center;">${coeffSym}<sub>k,${j+1}</sub> (${coeffUnit}) &middot; ${unkSym}<sub>${j+1}</sub></th>`;
  }
  html += `<th style="font-size:0.72rem; color:#5b21b6; text-align:center;">= ${srcSym}<sub>source</sub> (${srcUnit})</th></tr></thead><tbody>`;

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    html += '<tr>';
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      html += `<td><input type="number" step="any" id="matM_${i}_${j}" value="${preset.M[i][j]}" oninput="solveMatrix()"></td>`;
    }
    html += `<td><input type="number" step="any" id="matS_${i}" value="${preset.S[i]}" oninput="solveMatrix()" style="border-color:#c084fc; background:#faf5ff;"></td></tr>`;
  }
  html += '</tbody></table>';
  container.innerHTML = html;
  solveMatrix();
};

function det2(m) { return m[0][0]*m[1][1] - m[0][1]*m[1][0]; }
function det3(m) {
  return m[0][0]*(m[1][1]*m[2][2] - m[1][2]*m[2][1])
       - m[0][1]*(m[1][0]*m[2][2] - m[1][2]*m[2][0])
       + m[0][2]*(m[1][0]*m[2][1] - m[1][1]*m[2][0]);
}

window.solveMatrix = function() {
  const n = activeMatrixDim;
  const domain = document.getElementById('matDomain').value;
  const out = document.getElementById('matrixReadout');
  const M = [];
  const S = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const row = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      row.push(parseFloat(document.getElementById(`matM_${i}_${j}`).value) || 0);
    }
    M.push(row);
    S.push(parseFloat(document.getElementById(`matS_${i}`).value) || 0);
  }

  const D = n === 2 ? det2(M) : det3(M);
  if (Math.abs(D) < 1e-12) {
    out.innerHTML = `<span class="dash-readout-orange">Singular Matrix: det = 0 (No unique solution). Check dependent loops or floating nodes.</span>`;
    return;
  }

  const X = [];
  const detN = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const Mk = M.map((row, rIdx) => row.map((val, cIdx) => cIdx === k ? S[rIdx] : val));
    const Dk = n === 2 ? det2(Mk) : det3(Mk);
    detN.push(Dk);
    X.push(Dk / D);
  }

  const unkSym = domain === 'mesh' ? 'I' : 'V';
  const unkUnit = domain === 'mesh' ? 'A' : 'V';

  const solStr = X.map((val, idx) => {
    const subStr = domain === 'mesh' ? ` (${(val*1000).toFixed(1)} mA)` : '';
    return `${unkSym}<sub>${idx+1}</sub> = <span class="dash-readout-accent">${val.toFixed(4)} ${unkUnit}</span><span style="color:#38bdf8;">${subStr}</span>`;
  }).join(' | ');

  const cramerStr = detN.map((dk, idx) => `&Delta;<sub>${idx+1}</sub>=${dk.toFixed(2)}`).join(', ');
  const diffLabel = domain === 'mesh'
    ? `Shared Branch Current (${unkSym}<sub>1</sub> - ${unkSym}<sub>2</sub>) = ${(X[0] - X[1]).toFixed(4)} A`
    : `Shared Branch Voltage (${unkSym}<sub>1</sub> - ${unkSym}<sub>2</sub>) = ${(X[0] - X[1]).toFixed(4)} V`;

  out.innerHTML = `${solStr}<br>Cramer's Determinant: &Delta; = <span class="dash-readout-orange">${D.toFixed(4)}</span> (${cramerStr})<br><span style="color:#a1a1aa;">${diffLabel}</span>`;
};

function syncTelemetry() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('francillon_opamp_studio_v1');
    if (raw) {
      const s = JSON.parse(raw);
      const el = document.getElementById('opAmpTelemetry');
      if (el && s.mode) {
        el.textContent = `Last Active Bench: ${s.mode.toUpperCase()} | Rin=${s.rin || 2}kΩ, Rf=${s.rf || 10}kΩ`;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}
}

solveOhm();
solveTau();
solveResistor();
solveDb();
solveRlcZ();
solveEqNetwork();
renderPotd();
renderMatrixInputs();
syncTelemetry();
</script>
